claims.evidence: Two SILAC mixtures (metadata "Biological Replicate" 1 = files CTCL-PL-RH-1..8, 2 = CTCL-PH-RL-1..8), each the 1:1 mix of one HuT78 and one HuT78VR labelled culture ("each pair of forward and reverse SILAC experiments", PRIDE). One source name per labelled culture; each denotes one physical sample.

claims.value: SILAC light = HuT78 (vorinostat sensitive); SILAC heavy = HuT78VR (vorinostat resistant)
claims.evidence: metadata rows run_fraction_1_1..1_8: SILAC Heavy = HuT78VR, SILAC Light = HuT78, Biological Replicate 1, Data file CTCL-PL-RH-<band>. Independent: the file-name code PL-RH = Parental Light / Resistant Heavy. Data check: PD Resistant/Parental ratio, bio rep 1: CASP3 log2 -1.42, STAT3 -1.14 (abstract: "downregulation of caspase 3 and phosphorylated forms of STAT3 in HuT78VR"); same sign in bio rep 2 (-1.06, -0.94), whose orientation is reversed, so the per-mixture assignment is internally consistent.

Ratio consistency as in the mixture-1 claim.

limitations: No publication: PRIDE and ProteomeXchange list none and Europe PMC searches found no article for this deposit. All sample metadata come from the PRIDE protocol text, the deposited CTCL-SILAC_metadata.xlsx, the deposited PD export and Cellosaurus.

CTCL-SILAC_metadata.xlsx has typos: SILAC Heavy for replicate-2 fractions 2..8 reads HuT79..HuT85 (spreadsheet autofill of HuT78), and data-file dates for PL-RH-5..8 (20180903) and PH-RL-7..8 (20180831) differ from the deposited names (20180904 / 20180905). Interpreted as HuT78 and matched by unique file prefix; the file-name codes PL-RH / PH-RL independently give the same channel map.

Channel-map data check is consistency only: the PD ratios were computed by the depositor with the same design, so they cannot independently prove orientation; they do show both mixtures giving the same Resistant/Parental direction for CASP3 and STAT3, matching the abstract.

HuT78VR has no Cellosaurus entry; HuT78VR rows carry the parental HuT 78 accession (CVCL_0337) and are distinguished by characteristics[phenotype]. Whether HuT78VR was kept in vorinostat during SILAC labelling is not stated, so no treatment column is asserted.
Labelling kit "SILAC Protein Quantitation Kit (LysC)" labels only lysine; digestion was trypsin (PRIDE), so arginine-terminated peptides carry no label. Encoded as stated.
The 7.2 GB CTCL-SILAC.msf was not downloaded; search parameters (tolerances, modifications) come from the PRIDE data processing protocol, not from sdrf-tools search-params.
PRIDE v3 files API was unreachable (HTML error page/timeouts) throughout; the file scope comes from the FTP directory listing and the ProteomeXchange XML (identical 16 raw files).
Biological replicate independence: the two mixtures are forward/reverse labelling and therefore necessarily separate cultures; separate harvest dates are not stated.
techsdrf not installed; raw-file verification limited to range-read headers of 2 of 16 files (one per mixture).
Independent review not yet performed: REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL (external sdrf-adversarial-review hand-off).
